sample_unit: model responses (81 scenarios, 4 LLMs, repeated runs)

links.outcome: LLM dosing correctness on rolling 24-hour OTC dosing scenarios
links.effect: Models frequently struggle with rolling-window reasoning and ambiguity-sensitive cases; stable or confident-looking responses can still violate dosing constraints.
links.quote: Our results show that models frequently struggle with rolling-window reasoning and ambiguity-sensitive cases and that stable or confident-looking responses can still violate dosing constraints.

links.outcome: Consistency of LLM dosing answers across repeated runs
links.effect: Stable or confident-looking responses can still violate dosing constraints; consistency assessed across repeated runs, with 1,620 responses evaluated.
links.quote: Our results show that models frequently struggle with rolling-window reasoning and ambiguity-sensitive cases and that stable or confident-looking responses can still violate dosing constraints.

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM performance and safety on a novel benchmark (DOSEBENCH) of over-the-counter medication dosing questions without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
